realObservation.source: Closed pre-restart H2 backup opened read-only, compared with owned read-only History Event API
realObservation.finding: Order-dependent serialized coverage entered legacy payload fingerprints and invalidated otherwise reusable model windows after a JVM restart. Remaining comparison differences include DTO path sanitization and are not asserted as content-equivalent.

correction: Compare every source field and parsed JSON when hashes differ. Retain the old event/hash for equal content; changed coverage still invalidates. No global fingerprint migration or model call was added.
limitations: The regression models an older serialization with a synthetic fingerprint; it does not replace a real restart and no-change proof.
The first red invocation used an incorrect relative GH isolation lookup. Its local no-Git Agent-result fixture made no model or GitHub request. The corrected run used the existing isolated directory.
The read-only backup helper initially needed the existing H2 lowercase-schema setting and explicit UTF-8 CSV encoding; both were corrected before the comparison.

subsequentClosedDatabaseProof.source: Two exclusive-lock-confirmed closed H2 backups opened with ACCESS_MODE_DATA=r; canonical comparison excludes only update timestamp and fingerprint.
subsequentClosedDatabaseProof.interpretation: The earlier API comparison was a lower bound. Direct read-only comparisons of both closed databases confirm all 83 changed fingerprints had equal source content; no raw source rows are published.
